title: One atlas, four notebooks retired
brief: Our campaign's places live in four different notebooks, so every session starts with an argument about where the river actually runs.

target_population.role: game master maintaining a shared world atlas with four players
target_population.coverage_limit: one campaign world as text entries; no maps, dice, or rules content

core_task.summary: add a location to a region and confirm the backlink appears
core_task.success_oracle: adding the Gullwing Lighthouse to the Saltmarsh Coast region creates its entry and lists it in that region's backlinks immediately

not_applicable_states.loading: the atlas is seeded local text mutated in memory, so entries and backlinks appear in the same frame they are written

state_recipes.empty: open the Ember Steppe region, which has no seeded locations; the region page invites its first entry
state_recipes.validation-error: add a location named Gullwing Lighthouse a second time; a duplicate-entry error refuses it
state_recipes.success: add the Gullwing Lighthouse under Saltmarsh Coast; the entry renders with its region backlink live
state_recipes.focus: press Tab from page load until the location-name field shows its visible focus ring
state_recipes.mobile: load the atlas at 390x844; the region index collapses into a drawer above entries

acceptance_facts: The seed atlas holds nine locations across three regions authored by four fictional players.
Adding the Gullwing Lighthouse to the Saltmarsh Coast lists it in that region's backlinks immediately.
A location name that already exists anywhere in the atlas is refused with a duplicate-entry error.

product_signature.mechanism: region backlink web that keeps every place attached to where it belongs
product_signature.anchor: backlink panel on each region page
product_signature.brief_trace: an argument about where the river actually runs
product_signature.counterfactual: a flat notes wiki would fit a journal brief and lets places float unattached to any region
product_signature.task_proof: success capture shows the lighthouse entry with its Saltmarsh Coast backlink live

anti_goals: no dice rollers, stat blocks, or rules content
no drawn maps or image uploads; the atlas is deliberately textual
no real-time presence, chat, or notifications

content_seed.data_notes: nine invented locations across three regions; Ember Steppe is deliberately empty to fix the empty state, and the lighthouse becomes entry ten
